channel.title: RealHunt: new homes
channel.description: New homes on RealHunt, checked by a person and scored from 70 to 98.

item.title: €155,000 · Country house with pool on a 5,500 m² plot near Valdunciel, Salamanca
item.description: San Joaquín de Huelmos, Valdunciel, Salamanca. 151 m². RealHunt score 91. A rustic estate of about 5,500 m² in San Joaquín de Huelmos, Valdunciel, with a registered single-storey house of about 151 m². Three bedrooms and two bathrooms, a kitchen with mint-green units and a living room with a fireplace. Outside there is a swimming pool, sports areas and storage buildings. Asking €155,000, about €1,026/m².

item.title: €150,000 · Village house with a plant-filled terrace facing Castalla castle, with garage
item.description: Castalla, Alicante. 165 m². RealHunt score 91. A 165 m² house on two floors in Castalla. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a kitchen, a dining room and two living rooms. It has a private garage and extra storage, and the upstairs terrace has an open view of Castalla castle. Asking €150,000, about €909/m².

item.title: €159,900 · Renovated two-floor house with terrace in Piles, a quiet Valencian town by the sea
item.description: Piles, Valencia. 109 m². RealHunt score 91. A renovated house in the centre of Piles, ready to move into. The ground floor is an open space with living room and a modern red kitchen. Two bedrooms and two bathrooms over two floors, with several outside spaces including a terrace. A quiet town with all services, near the sea. Asking €159,900, about €1,467/m².

item.title: €155,000 · House fully renovated in 2024 with terrace and castle views in Santa Olalla del Cala, Sierra de Huelva
item.description: Santa Olalla del Cala, Huelva. 83 m². RealHunt score 91. A house in Santa Olalla del Cala, in the Sierra de Huelva and 45 minutes from Seville. 83 m² built on a 194 m² plot, with a full renovation done in 2024. Two bedrooms, a full bathroom and a living room with a fireplace. The garden and the terrace look at the castle. Asking €155,000, about €1,867/m².

item.title: €145,000 · Renovated four-bedroom Alpujarra house with a sunny porch and sea and mountain views in Nechite
item.description: Nechite, Alpujarra, Granada. 210 m². RealHunt score 91. A fully renovated house in Nechite, a village in the Alpujarra inside the Sierra Nevada area. Four large bedrooms, the main one with its own terrace and bathroom, and a second full bathroom. A sunny glazed porch, a living room under wooden beams and three fireplaces in the house. Views to the sea and the mountains. Asking €145,000, about €690/m².

item.title: €69,000 · Whitewashed four-bedroom village house with several terraces and big views in Líjar, Almería
item.description: Líjar, Almería. 237 m². RealHunt score 91. A roomy village house in excellent condition and ready to move into. Four bedrooms, a bathroom, several sitting areas and several terraces with views over the village and the hills. Líjar has a small supermarket, a doctor, bars and restaurants; Albox is 20 to 25 minutes by car. Asking €69,000, about €291/m².

item.title: €89,000 · Village house renovated in 2024 with a roof terrace and sierra views in Vélez-Blanco
item.description: Vélez-Blanco, Almería. 150 m². RealHunt score 91. A village house in Vélez-Blanco renovated in 2024 and ready to move into, with car access almost to the door. Four double bedrooms, one on the ground floor, a separate kitchen, a living room, a bathroom and a WC. The roof is completely new and the roof terrace looks at the Sierra de la Muela. Asking €89,000, about €593/m².

item.title: €63,000 · Bright traditional Aragonese house with a stone-floored entrance patio in Torre los Negros, Teruel
item.description: Torre los Negros, Teruel. 256 m². RealHunt score 91. A bright house ready to move into in Torre los Negros. The entrance patio keeps its Aragonese stone floor; the ground floor has a large living and dining room, a kitchen, a laundry room and a full bathroom. Two double bedrooms with alcoves on the first floor and two attic rooms under old beams above. Outside space for barbecues and a covered area. Asking €63,000, about €246/m².

item.title: €105,000 · Renovated two-bedroom mountain house with a vine-covered terrace in Tocón de Quéntar, Granada
item.description: Tocón de Quéntar, Granada. 72 m². RealHunt score 91. A cosy renovated house in Tocón de Quéntar, in the hills east of Granada. 72 m² built with two double bedrooms, a full bathroom and a living room with an open kitchen around a central wood stove. The private terrace has open mountain views. Asking €105,000, about €1,458/m².

item.title: €139,000 · Single-storey house renovated four years ago with a pool in a 120 m² patio in Madrigueras, Albacete
item.description: Madrigueras, Albacete. 180 m². RealHunt score 91. A single-storey house in Madrigueras, 20 minutes from Albacete, renovated about four years ago. The 120 m² patio is fully fitted out with a pool, a nearly new filter, a barbecue, a wooden pergola and an outdoor dining area. Inside, a furnished and equipped kitchen with a living area, two bedrooms and a bathroom. Asking €139,000, about €772/m².

item.title: €68,500 · Restored single-storey Alentejo house with reed ceilings near Mértola
item.description: Penilhos, Mértola, Beja. 75 m². RealHunt score 91. A typical single-storey Alentejo house in Penilhos, about 20 km from Mértola and 25 km from Castro Verde. Recently rehabilitated keeping the original features: traditional wooden interior doors, reed ceilings and an Alentejo kitchen. Living room, kitchen, two bedrooms and two bathrooms, in good condition. Easy access and parking in the street. Asking €68,500, about €913/m².

item.title: €110,000 · Five-bedroom house with two kitchens, central heating and a new roof in Silvares, Fundão
item.description: Silvares, Fundão, Castelo Branco. 176 m². RealHunt score 91. A five-bedroom house on four floors in Silvares, with good-sized rooms throughout. Two fitted kitchens, two bathrooms, a large living and dining room, a basement and an attic. Balconies look out over the village, there is central heating and the roof was renovated recently. Energy certificate D. Asking €110,000, about €625/m².

item.title: €150,000 · Renovated two-bedroom house with air conditioning in the historic quarter of Estremoz
item.description: Estremoz, Évora. 110 m². RealHunt score 91. A two-bedroom house in the historic quarter of Estremoz, renovated with respect for its original lines. Recent work on the roof and new window frames, and air conditioning in four rooms for the Alentejo summer and winter. Ready to move into. Asking €150,000, about €1,364/m².

item.title: €145,000 · Fully remodelled three-storey house 50 metres from the town gates of Castelo de Vide
item.description: Castelo de Vide, Portalegre. 126 m². RealHunt score 91. A fully remodelled house on three floors in the heart of Castelo de Vide, 50 metres from the town gates and the historic centre. Two bedrooms and two bathrooms, a new white kitchen and pine floors upstairs. 126 m², whitewashed outside like the rest of the street. Asking €145,000, about €1,151/m².

item.title: €125,000 · Detached five-bedroom house with garden, garage and central heating in Brunhoso, Mogadouro
item.description: Brunhoso, Mogadouro, Bragança. 170 m². RealHunt score 91. A detached house open on all four sides in the quiet village of Brunhoso. The ground floor has a good garage, a laundry, a shower room and the boiler for the central heating, plus a garden with a barbecue area and a borehole. The first floor has a fitted kitchen with an open fireplace and a balcony, a living room and a dining room. Asking €125,000, about €735/m².

item.title: €100,000 · Five-bedroom house with garage and balconies in a Trás-os-Montes village near Miranda do Douro
item.description: São Pedro da Silva, Miranda do Douro, Bragança. 158 m². RealHunt score 91. A five-bedroom house in the centre of São Pedro da Silva, in Miranda do Douro. 238 m² of built area over three floors with a garage and balconies, and bright rooms with wooden floors. A roomy home for a large family or a second residence in Trás-os-Montes. Asking €100,000, about €633/m².

item.title: €115,000 · Fully remodelled Alentejo village house with wooden ceilings in Chança, Alter do Chão
item.description: Chança, Alter do Chão, Portalegre. 130 m². RealHunt score 91. A fully remodelled semi-detached house in Chança, a calm Alentejo village in Alter do Chão. White rooms under painted wooden ceilings, a new fitted kitchen, air conditioning and a mezzanine room against an exposed stone wall. Ready to move into. Energy certificate D. Asking €115,000, about €885/m².

item.title: €150,000 · Fully renovated three-storey village house in Peso, Covilhã, below Serra da Estrela
item.description: Peso, Covilhã, Castelo Branco. 86 m². RealHunt score 91. A fully renovated townhouse in the centre of Peso, close to shops and services. Open-plan kitchen and living room with a guest WC on the ground floor, a bright bedroom on the first floor, and a second bedroom with a full bathroom on the top floor. PVC double-glazed windows throughout. Asking €150,000, about €1,744/m².

item.title: €145,000 · Furnished village house with terrace and hill views, ready to move into, in Mação
item.description: Castelo, Mação, Santarém. 96 m². RealHunt score 91. A house on two floors in the quiet village of Castelo, in Mação, in excellent condition and sold furnished. Upstairs a large living room with a wood burner and an open, fully equipped kitchen, plus bedrooms with fitted wardrobes that look over the green hills. A sitting room and a bathroom downstairs, and a terrace. Asking €145,000, about €1,510/m².

item.title: €117,500 · Furnished three-bedroom house ready to move into, 5 km from Vila Nova de Paiva
item.description: Touro, Vila Nova de Paiva, Viseu. 144 m². RealHunt score 91. A three-bedroom house sold fully furnished and ready to live in, in a quiet spot 5 km from Vila Nova de Paiva. Solid structure with granite stone walls, an interior in good condition with no signs of damp. Large kitchen with a fireplace, dining room, three bedrooms and a bathroom. The furniture is classic Portuguese carved wood. Asking €117,500, about €816/m².

item.title: €148,400 · Brick house with a 2019 living-room extension, garden and garage in Ohain, Avesnois
item.description: Ohain, Nord. 106 m². RealHunt score 91. A semi-detached brick house in the green Avesnois, next to the Belgian border. The living space with dining area, kitchen and lounge sits in an extension built in 2019, with a shower room on the same floor. Three bedrooms upstairs. PVC double glazing throughout, mains drainage and a redone electrical panel. Terrace, garden, a large garage and parking on 490 m². Energy rating D. Asking €148,400, about €1,400/m².

item.title: €137,900 · Renovated old house with stone walls and terracotta floors in the Perche, 3 minutes from Nogent-le-Rotrou
item.description: Val-au-Perche, Orne. 81 m². RealHunt score 91. A renovated old house in a hamlet of only three houses, with an open view, three minutes from Nogent-le-Rotrou. The living room keeps its terracotta tiles and stone walls, with a pellet stove and an open fitted kitchen. Three bedrooms and a shower room upstairs. A front courtyard and a small garden with trees on 386 m². Energy rating D. Asking €137,900, about €1,702/m².

item.title: €134,375 · Furnished old stone house with a 53 m² living room and 2,825 m² of garden in Bessac, Charente
item.description: Bessac, Charente. 116 m². RealHunt score 91. A characterful old house sold fully furnished. The ground floor has a 53 m² living room under exposed beams with a wood stove and a fitted kitchen, opening to a terrace with open countryside views. Two bedrooms and a bathroom upstairs, a cellar, and 2,825 m² of enclosed garden with trees. Drainage is compliant. Windows are single-glazed timber and the energy rating is E. Asking €134,375, about €1,158/m².

item.title: €123,000 · Fully renovated 19th-century longère on one level with garage in Lencloître, Vienne
item.description: Lencloître, Vienne. 102 m². RealHunt score 91. A 19th-century longère, fully renovated and all on one level. East and west light fills a living room, lounge and dining room; the modern kitchen is separate. Two bedrooms, a laundry, a garage and a 620 m² garden with a terrace. Energy rating D. Asking €123,000, about €1,206/m².

item.title: €139,000 · Former level-crossing keeper's house renovated in 2023 on 1,824 m² in Bergerac, Dordogne
item.description: Bergerac, Dordogne. 77 m². RealHunt score 91. An old level-crossing keeper's house, 2.5 km from the centre of Bergerac, fully renovated in 2023. Downstairs a fully equipped kitchen opens to the dining room, with a bedroom, a shower room and a laundry on the same level. Upstairs a landing room for an office and a large bedroom. The fenced 1,824 m² plot has a well and a vaulted cellar. Energy rating D. Asking €139,000, about €1,805/m².

item.title: €109,760 · Stone country house from 1550 with a mezzanine and 1,686 m² of land in Nieuil, Charente
item.description: Nieuil, Charente. 116 m². RealHunt score 91. A stone country house dating from 1550 in a quiet hamlet, 5 km from shops. It was renovated between 2005 and 2010: the old part keeps a living room with a big fireplace and a bedroom, the renovated part has an open fitted kitchen, a shower room and a mezzanine under the roof. Semi-detached, on 1,686 m² of land with trees. Asking €109,760, about €946/m².

item.title: €146,990 · Tastefully renovated stone-fronted house with full basement near the station in Salbris, Sologne
item.description: Salbris, Loir-et-Cher. 83 m². RealHunt score 91. A fully renovated house in the centre of Salbris, close to shops and the train station. Fitted kitchen, a bright living room and a bedroom with its own shower on the ground floor; two more bedrooms and a bathroom upstairs. Reversible air conditioning, PVC windows with electric shutters, a full basement and a terrace on a fenced 665 m² plot. Energy rating D. Asking €146,990, about €1,771/m².

item.title: €136,250 · Renovated stone house with open countryside views and a heat pump near Saint-Vaury, Creuse
item.description: near Saint-Vaury, Creuse. 98 m². RealHunt score 91. A renovated stone house with a wide open view over the Creuse countryside. Dining room with fitted kitchen, a lounge and a shower room downstairs; a landing office, two bedrooms and a second shower room upstairs. Air-to-air heat pump on the ground floor, compliant drainage and energy rating C. 931 m² of land. Asking €136,250, about €1,390/m².

item.title: €125,000 · Renovated stone house with a 60 m² living space and mezzanine near Villefagnan, Charente
item.description: Villefagnan, Charente. 153 m². RealHunt score 91. A well renovated stone house in a hamlet 2 km from Villefagnan and 7 km from Ruffec. The 60 m² living space has a 12 kW wood stove and an open fitted kitchen with a 12.5 m² pantry. A bedroom, a walk-in shower room and a WC are on the ground floor; a 19.5 m² mezzanine and two more bedrooms upstairs. 153 m² on a 1,334 m² plot. Energy rating D. Asking €125,000, about €817/m².

item.title: €149,000 · Fully renovated 250 m² house from 1900 with five bedrooms in La Courtine, Creuse
item.description: La Courtine, Creuse. 250 m². RealHunt score 91. A traditional house from 1900, fully renovated, in a village with all services. A large bright living room, an open fitted kitchen, a bedroom and a shower room make a complete ground floor. Four bedrooms and a second shower room upstairs, and one more room on the top floor. Built over a cellar with a boiler room and workshop, with a tended garden of 876 m². Energy rating D. Asking €149,000, about €596/m².

item.title: €115,000 · Furnished lake-view house in the old centre of San Siro, Lake Como
item.description: San Siro, Lake Como, Lombardy. 85 m². RealHunt score 91. An 85 m² restored, habitable semi-detached house in the car-free historic centre of San Siro, on the west shore of Lake Como. Two floors plus a mezzanine: entrance hall, bedroom and shower room downstairs; a bright living room with fireplace and wooden beams and a separate kitchen upstairs; an attic bedroom with two Velux windows. Lake views from the living floor and the mezzanine. Sold fully furnished, with a separate cellar. Asking €115,000, about €1,353/m².

item.title: €290,000 · Spacious five-bedroom apartment in the heart of Vejer de la Frontera
item.description: Vejer de la Frontera. 191 m². RealHunt score 81. This 178 m² apartment offers five bedrooms and two bathrooms in Vejer de la Frontera, one of Andalusia's most sought-after coastal villages. The home features bright, well-maintained interiors with clean white walls, arched doorways, wooden furnishings, and a rooftop terrace with decorative tilework. The location in the town center provides access to local amenities and the charming character of this whitewashed Andalusian village.

item.title: €290,000 · Spacious five-bedroom apartment in the heart of Vejer de la Frontera
item.description: Vejer de la Frontera. 191 m². RealHunt score 82. This 178 m² apartment offers five bedrooms and two bathrooms in Vejer de la Frontera, one of Andalusia's most sought-after coastal towns. The home features bright, well-maintained interiors with arched doorways, wooden furnishings, and a terrace with countryside views. The property is in good condition and priced 24% below the area median.

item.title: €348,000 · Bright duplex apartment with exposed brick in central Madrid
item.description: Embajadores-Lavapiés, Madrid. 71 m². RealHunt score 72. Two-bedroom duplex in the vibrant Embajadores-Lavapiés neighbourhood, just 0.9 km from the city centre. Split-level design with high ceilings, industrial steel beams, and authentic exposed brick walls throughout. Original character well-preserved with modern finishes; ground floor placement provides direct street access.

item.title: €255,000 · Renovated two-bedroom flat with modern finishes in Embajadores-Lavapiés, Madrid
item.description: Embajadores-Lavapiés, Madrid. 50 m². RealHunt score 71. Recently renovated with bright, well-lit spaces and clean modern finishes throughout. Features an open-plan living-dining area and a separate kitchen. Located in the central Embajadores-Lavapiés neighborhood just 1.1 km from Madrid's city center.

item.title: €188,000 · Renovated four-bedroom house with terrace in Palmete, Seville
item.description: Palmete, Sevilla. 130 m². RealHunt score 80. Recently reformed chalet ready to move into immediately. Spacious 130 m² distributed over two floors with four bedrooms and two bathrooms. Bright living areas with large windows and a well-maintained modern interior throughout.

item.title: €199,000 · Bright renovated three-bedroom flat with modern kitchen in Bellavista, Sevilla
item.description: Bellavista, Sevilla. 100 m². RealHunt score 80. Fully renovated in 2025 with excellent natural light throughout. Open-plan modern kitchen with fitted appliances and patterned backsplash. Three spacious bedrooms plus one bathroom in a second-floor interior/exterior unit.

item.title: €197,000 · Bright four-bedroom apartment with community pool in Palmete, Sevilla
item.description: Palmete, Sevilla. 105 m². RealHunt score 83. This sixth-floor apartment offers abundant natural light and spacious interiors with a balanced layout across 105 m². It includes four bedrooms, two bathrooms, air conditioning, a garage, and storage room in a well-maintained residential building with a community pool. The contemporary furnishings and terrazzo flooring create a clean, modern aesthetic.

item.title: €134,400 · Updated first-floor two-bedroom condo near the beach in Maybury Mansions, Fort Lauderdale
item.description: Maybury Mansions, Fort Lauderdale, Florida. 81 m². RealHunt score 86. Renovated with modern finishes, light-filled spaces, and private outdoor access on the first floor. Located minutes from the beach, downtown Fort Lauderdale, and Las Olas dining. Owner-occupied community with stable occupancy supports conventional financing. Flexible possession available.

item.title: €279,600 · Mid-century ranch with open floor plan and mature oaks in Herchel Heights, Tampa
item.description: Herchel Heights Rev, Tampa, Florida. 177 m². RealHunt score 87. Charming 1958 ranch home with recently renovated interior featuring soaring ceilings, exposed wood ceiling details, and wood-look tile flooring. Open floor plan with seamless indoor-outdoor flow to a fully fenced backyard with patio. Close to parks, the Hillsborough River, and major highways for easy Tampa commuting.
